title: KnobCatalog
description: Every serve flag of one model server (vLLM or SGLang) that is a knob (one value, not one servtuner sets itself), with its description, type, default and limits taken from the server's own source at the pinned version. servtuner knobs [--server sglang] prints it from the catalogs it embeds; the api serves it at GET /knobs[?server=sglang].

server.description: The model server the catalog describes.

version.description: The server release the catalog was read from.

commit.description: The server's source commit at that release.

other_flags.description: Every other spelling the server accepts at this version: the flags that are not knobs (JSON and list flags, the ones servtuner sets), with their aliases and off spellings, sorted. With the knobs' flags it is how a base flag is told from a typo.

name.description: The knob's name: <server>.<the server's field name>, as vllm.max_num_seqs or sglang.mem_fraction_static.

label.description: A short name for people ("Max sequences"), never the flag.

flag.description: vLLM's long flag; empty for a field set through --compilation-config.

negative_flags.description: The spellings that turn a boolean off (--no-x, --disable-x).

group.description: vLLM's argument group, the config class the field belongs to.

default.description: vLLM's argparse default; null when vLLM decides at start-up.

choices.description: The values vLLM accepts, when it enforces a closed set.

suggestions.description: Known values vLLM lists without enforcing them.

help.description: vLLM's own description of the field, as written in its source.

built_in.description: servtuner labels it and also reads it from a running target's /server_info; every listed knob can be deployed, captured and tuned.

tuned_as_range.description: A search space may give it as min and max instead of values: the tuning advisors move it (servtuner propose).

knobLimits.title: KnobLimits
knobLimits.description: Bounds from vLLM's Field(ge/gt/le/lt); cross-field rules are vLLM's to check at start-up.
